definition: RiTa is an open-source software toolkit for generative writing and English natural language, originally developed using the Java language by Daniel C.
details: Howe and collaborators, and later implemented in JavaScript as rita.js. Current versions of RiTa (Version 3.0 was released in 2023) are implemented in both Java and JavaScript and integrate with p5.js, Processing, Node and Android.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is RiTa — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
